svg.title: RustSpice: differentiable SPICE circuit simulation
svg.desc: SPICE netlists and device equations lower into SoA SIMD/GPU kernels and topology-specialized sparse solvers to produce transient waveforms and adjoint gradients.
svg.text: SPICE NETLIST → SOA & JIT LU → WAVEFORMS & ∂V/∂θ
MP1 out in1 vdd vdd PMOD
rustspice run examples/cmos_ring_oscillator.sp --backend cpu && rustspice adjoint net.sp --target-node out
